maria: Compliment baton! Tag someone and drop a two-word compliment. I'll start: 'Sunshine debugger' :sparkles:

alex: @maria — love it. 'Snack whisperer' :baguette_bread:

jamal: @alex lol. 'Latency slayer' :zap:

sara: @jamal tagging @leo — 'Spreadsheet wizard' :sparkles:

leo: thanks @sara — 'Queue tamer' :shield:

maria: Bonus: if you're WFH, raise an emoji for a virtual toast. :clinking_glasses:

alex: :clinking_glasses: cheers from the couch. 'Cat whisperer' (no cats harmed) :cat:

jamal: :raised_hands: WFH + kids + lunch = heroic. 'Calm hurricane' :tornado:

sara: @ops-bot can you set a reminder for next week's baton? :robot_face:

ops-bot: reminder set for next Monday 10:00am — "Compliment Baton" :bell:

leo: tiny confession: I sometimes debug while making pancakes. 'Butter whisperer' :pancakes:

maria: love these. New rule: you must also say one non-work thing you're proud of today. I'll go — 'Made sourdough' and 'Kept houseplant alive' :seedling:

alex: 'Beat the level' (video game) and 'Called mom' :heart:

jamal: 'Finally finished' (bookshelf) and 'Planted basil' :herb:

sara: 'Painted frame' and 'Took long walk' :deciduous_tree:

maria: Okay passing baton to @alex — your turn, add someone new! :rocket:
